1 (Currently amended): A catheter system for delivering ultrasonic energy to a treatment site within a body lumen, the catheter comprising: a tubular body having a proximal end, a distal end and an energy delivery section positioned between the proximal end and the distal end; wherein the ultrasound radiating members of one electrical group are spatially interdigitated with the ultrasound radiating members of another electrical group, and wherein the ultrasound radiating members are interdigitated in a __non-regular pattern__.

4 (Currently amended): The catheter system of Claim 1, wherein the ultrasound radiating members are interdigitated in a __non-regular pattern__.

5 (Currently amended): The catheter system of Claim 1, wherein the ultrasound radiating members are interdigitated in a __randomized pattern__.

6 (Currently amended): A system for treating a patient having pulmonary embolism, the system comprising: a first and a second ultrasound catheter, each of the first and the second ultrasound catheter comprising a tubular body having a proximal portion and a distal portion, the distal portion comprising an ultrasound energy delivery section having at least one ultrasound element, the tubular body also including at least one fluid delivery lumen; and a control system __configured to operate both the first and the second ultrasound catheters__.

7 (Currently amended): The system of Claim 6, wherein the control system operates both the first and the second ultrasound catheters simultaneously.

8 (Currently amended): The system of Claim 7, wherein the control system is configured to independently control the ultrasound radiating members on the first and the second ultrasound catheters.
